messages.content: What cognitive assessments were administered and what were the composite scores?

The Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children (WISC-V) was administered. The student obtained a Full Scale IQ (FSIQ) composite score of 88, placing performance in the Low Average range (25th percentile).

list_summaries_response_200.summary:
Psychoeducational Evaluation Summary

Student diagnosed with Specific Learning Disability in Reading (Dyslexia). WISC-V FSIQ: 88 (Low Average). WIAT-4 Word Reading: 74 (4th percentile). Recommendations include Orton-Gillingham instruction and extended time accommodations.
